Dear Friends of Europe Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Assistant traineeship. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media, and WordPress, I am eager to bring my skills to your Communications Team and contribute to your mission of fostering debate on European and global affairs.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have also developed mirook.com, where I implemented structured data and optimized content for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience has honed my ability to craft clear, engaging messages and adapt content for different platforms.

I am particularly drawn to Friends of Europe because of its influential role in policy discussions. I am a quick learner, well-organized, and comfortable working in multicultural teams. I am available to start in late September and am excited about the opportunity to develop my skills further while supporting your communications efforts.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Friends of Europe Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Communications Assistant traineeship at Friends of Europe. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your Communications Team and gain hands-on experience in a think tank environment.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have developed a robust skill set directly relevant to this position. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This experience has taught me how to craft compelling messages that resonate with target audiences and how to optimize content for maximum visibility. Additionally, I have hands-on experience with social media integration and performance tracking using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs.

My personal project, mirook.com, further demonstrates my initiative and technical capabilities. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema), and ran iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve its visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project honed my ability to work independently and pay close attention to detail.

I am particularly drawn to Friends of Europe because of its reputation as an independent and influential think tank. I am passionate about European and global affairs and eager to contribute to the dissemination of information through social media and other channels. I am a highly motivated, solution-oriented individual who thrives in multicultural teams and is comfortable working under deadlines.

I am available to start in late September and am excited about the prospect of combining full-time work experience with hands-on training. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
